value.rationale: The exact complete optimizer-set classification is a natural equality problem left unresolved by existence/averaging results: odd cycles have a unique signed optimal center while even cycles have a simplex of arbitrarily many dimensions, and the new-point metric parameter sharply changes to a full-dimensional norm-optimal polytope. The signed positivity rigidity is structurally nontrivial and matters for all simultaneous real-linear extension operators, not just probability constructions.
